items.title: Social Security Reform Could Put ADP Stock Back On More Watchlists
items.summary: Social Security reform has suddenly shifted from a distant talking point to a live policy question, and payroll and HR services stocks are right in that crossfire. Tax caps, benefit formulas and any move toward individual investment accounts could reshape how employers handle every paycheck. This article walks through three U.S. payroll and HR firms exposed to that debate, and explores where the current policy noise might help or hurt their shares.
